summary: Read a digit string n whose length is from 1 to 105. It has no leading zero and stands for a positive integer. Call a positive integer special when every digit is 0 or 1 and the integer itself has no leading zero. Find how few special positive integers are needed so that they add up to n, and write that minimum count.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
